correctness.rationale: Finite-dimensional convex energy gives a unique global p-heat solution. For distinct Cartesian directions, monotone edge flux yields a two-input vertex ℓ1 Kato inequality between fibers. The own-direction BV inequality follows from factor hypotheses, and subadditivity of one-sided directional derivatives proves the product claim. Coordinate-only data give necessity. Explicit edge-gradient and sorted-coordinate identities prove all claimed factors; single-leaf star test yields exact strict derivative at four leaves. Finite diagnostics test 393660 integer-exact derivative inequalities, not substituted for proof.
